FUNCTION FIND_PAIRS ACCEPTS(arr, target)
  pairs <- EMPTY LIST
  FOR i FROM 0 TO LENGTH OF arr - 1
    FOR j FROM i + 1 TO LENGTH OF arr - 1
      IF arr[i] + arr[j] == target THEN
        pairs <- pairs + [(arr[i], arr[j])]
      END IF
    END FOR
  END FOR
  RETURN pairs
END FUNCTION
